## Checklist

- [ ] **No client-identifying data** — client names replaced with `Contoso`/`Acme`; no real
      server IPs, client domains, email addresses, credentials, or connection strings
      (including in "before" examples and commit history)
- [ ] **New/updated case follows the template** in
      `skills/bpal-premises-support/CONTRIBUTING.md` (Presents as → Method → Root cause →
      Fix → Corrections → Verified)
- [ ] **SKILL.md touched only as an index** — at most one new row in the recurring-faults
      table; all detail lives in `reference/`
- [ ] **Verified on a real server** — the case records the date and evidence, and separates
      what was *measured* from what is *expected*
- [ ] **Corrections/dead ends kept** — wrong theories and what disproved them are recorded,
      not deleted
